mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reportId, r.post_id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, r.reason AS reason, r.description AS description, r.evidence AS evidenceJson, r.weight AS weight, r.status AS status, r.is_false_report AS isFalseReport, p.risk_score AS riskScore, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.handled_at AS handledAt, r.handler_id AS handlerId FROM report r JOIN post p ON p.id = r.post_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
